sourceFacts.fact: A Meckel diverticulum can contain ectopic gastric tissue.
Acid produced by gastric tissue can ulcerate adjacent small intestine and cause bleeding, often painless.

layout: Four concept cards form a clean left-to-right sequence of three arrows. First label accompanied only by a neutral location pin marked Ectopic, no tissue sample. Second plain H+ paper coins. Third a cracked ivory tile as a damage metaphor, explicitly no bowel section or ulcer image. Fourth a red drop token next to the word Bleeding. Small note: A possible mechanism when gastric tissue is present. Title contains Meckel, but do not draw a diverticulum, intestine, pouch or organs.
